command:
for p in /tmp /dev/shm; do probe="$p/.mount_hardening_probe"; cp /bin/true "$probe"; chmod 4755 "$probe"; printf '%s mode=%s
' "$p" "$(stat -c %a "$probe")"; if "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s EXEC_UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED
' "$p"; exit 1; else printf '%s execution_blocked rc=%s
' "$p" "$?"; fi; dev="$p/.nodev_probe"; mknod "$dev" c 1 3; if dd if="$dev" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s DEVICE_UNEXPECTEDLY_USABLE
' "$p"; exit 1; else printf '%s device_access_blocked rc=%s
' "$p" "$?"; fi; rm -f "$probe" "$dev"; done
